items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I stayed there from January 1929 to May 1930, in the pit, and the musicians were Parker Berry on trombone, Lee Gibson on drums, Sturdivant on first sax, Barnett on second sax, and Hugo Dandridge on third sax.
